record.dic_text:
05651 `Ebed {eh'-bed}

與 05650 同; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Ebed 6; 6

以別 = "僕人"
1) 士師時代的人, 迦勒的父親 (#士 9:26|)
2) 約拿單的兒子, 亞丁的後裔, 他是隨以斯拉回歸的人之一 (#拉 8:6|)
record.edic_text:
05651 `Ebed {eh'-bed}

the same as 05650;; n pr m

AV - Ebed 6; 6

Ebed = "servant"
1) father of Gaal in the time of the judges
2) son of Jonathan and one of the sons of Adin who returned from
   exile with Ezra
